name: gremlin 1, DAN family BMP antagonist

function.text: GREM1 encodes gremlin-1. Annotated molecular activities include morphogen activity and protein homodimerization activity. It participates in signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to hereditary mixed polyposis syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
